external_provider_policy: No external LLM/vector provider is called; provider boundaries are mocked and any test error is product/test infrastructure, not an external-provider result.

cases.expected_state: Ticket OPEN is persisted with a TICKET_CREATED audit actor/timestamp.
One ticket retains exactly one user and one assistant message for the follow-up.
Ticket is WAITING_FOR_AGENT without an assignee or human-mode claim.
Only an authorized actor assigns the ticket and records the state transition.
API status, closed/reopened DB state and rating agree; invalid transition is rejected.
Service request is persisted separately from Incident and uses catalog routing.
Retry creates one ticket; DB timeout creates no ticket and leaks no internal error.
Failed tool state never renders a completion claim.
Cross-user/tenant access and user-provided role claims do not grant access.
Conflicting takeovers leave one consistent human-owned persisted state.
Completed stream persists one message pair; reconnect is read-only.
